## Implementation
- Commit `ebf371f`, cherry-picked from worktree commit `90d2048` (built on `5fbb86a`). Checked against `5fbb86a`: the line numbers in the ticket were still correct.
- The new #288 block in `cli/crow_core.py`:
  - `hosts_in` finds hosts in a text; `known_hosts` builds the set from user text (`user_words`), tool results and the carried hosts line. The assistant's own text never counts.
  - `adopt_known_hosts` runs at turn start; `note_known_hosts` runs after each tool result, so the links of a fetched page release the next call.
  - `_hosts_on_disk` reads the goal and PLAN.md lazily.
  - `_unnamed_host` is the guard itself. Loopback and LAN IPs pass, and so does a subdomain of a host that was named.
- `render_page` checks the guard before `find_browser`, so a refused call starts no browser. `fetch_url` uses the same guard.
- Rollover: the note carries `Web hosts this conversation named, carried across the cut: …` (the newest 60), read back only before the fixed `Full record` line, so the model's digest cannot carry a host.
- **Wording differs from the ticket:** the answer starts with `error: refused: <host> appears nowhere in this conversation -- a URL you made up?`, so the failure counters see it.
- Docs: `docs/reference/tools.md`, new "remote host (#288)" row.
- Tests: `RemoteHostsMustHaveBeenNamedTests` (7) and `TheHostGuardInsideATurnTests` (1, the real loop in yolo). Mutation reds, e.g. `Expected 'find_browser' to not have been called. Called 2 times.`
- Known gap: a host the model writes into a file and then reads back counts as named.
- Suites at `005fef6` (local `main`, unpushed, installed via install.sh 2026-09-24 ~23:00): 2,872 tests OK (8 skipped), ruff clean, `check_shared_core` 83/83.
- **Not verified live.** Recipe: in the next diorama run, 0 remote `render_page` calls to hosts the conversation never named.

## Released in v2.6.0
- Shipped in tag `v2.6.0` (merge `21d7505`, release PR #291, https://github.com/nibor1896/Crow/releases/tag/v2.6.0), installed on robin's machine via install.sh; `crow.py` VERSION 2.6.0, `install.sh --selftest` 39/39.
- CI on the release PR: ubuntu-latest and windows-latest green.
- Closed on merge on robin's word (2026-09-24: ship and close everything shipped). Where the implementation comment lists a live check that has not been run yet, it is **still pending**; a failure found later reopens this ticket.
